rationale: CR-001 is resolved: the fix-up (ba4fc5cc7f, test-only, +36 lines in one file, signature 84c414bf matches) adds a live test that seeds one slash-started skill (dispatch hook) and one Skill-tool skill (TOOL span) in a single session, then asserts both are skill bars, none is a command bar, and detail skill_count == len(bars) == 2. That ties the SQL skill_count to the handler's dispatch kinds, which was the gap. The mutation check in the fix evidence (old handler branch restored gives ('command · slashme','command') instead of ('skill · slashme','skill')) shows the test fails when the original defect is reintroduced. No production code changed in the fix-up, so no new high-risk issue was possible and the narrow confirmation pass was not needed. Carried forward unchanged: round-1 dismissals and the accepted limitations (existence-based exclusion is all-or-nothing per session and name; the correlated predicate's cost was not measured on production-sized data).

business_review.item: AC1: A skill started with a slash command is shown with kind skill in Session Detail
business_review.notes: _dispatch_label_and_kind drops the is_slash_command branch; pinned by test_a_slash_started_skill_row_is_a_skill_dispatch and the is_slash_command 0/1 parametrized test; the three duration tests and the live pricing test select the row by kind skill.

business_review.item: AC2: Session Detail Skills count and timeline skill bars agree for the same session
business_review.notes: Resolved in the check round: test_live_session_skill_count_matches_the_skill_bars_however_each_skill_was_started asserts detail skill_count == len(skill bars) == 2 for a session with one slash-started and one Skill-tool skill, through the reader and get_session_detail path.

business_review.item: AC3: Tools & Models lists a slash-started skill under Skills only (decision: Skills only)
business_review.notes: _not_a_skill_of_session on both kind-4 branches of get_invocations and get_class_lists; live test test_live_a_slash_started_skill_is_listed_under_skills_only covers the OTel and summary paths, handler get_tools, and class lists equal to counts; passed on PG 17 and 14.

business_review.item: AC4: Plain slash commands that are not skills stay classified as commands
business_review.notes: Live test keeps compact (3), orphan (no kind-2 row in its session) and inlineme typed in a session without a skill row under slash_commands; a plain command never produces a dispatch row, so the handler test asserts None for a row with neither skill nor agent.

business_review.item: AC5: Cost, token and duration attribution of slash-started skills unchanged
business_review.notes: No dispatch SQL cost/duration column or ORDER BY changed (comments only); the three handler duration assertions are unchanged apart from the kind selector; live pricing test cost values and sum == session cost unchanged and passing on PG 17 and 14.

business_review.item: Per-session exclusion, summary path, no-hook case, class-list/count agreement (Review Focus 1-4)
business_review.notes: Seeded in the live test (typed_only, summary, no_hook sessions) with classes == set(counts).

standards_review.notes: All three commits follow EPMCDME-####: Description, including the fix-up (EPMCDME-17201: Pin Session Detail skill count to the skill bars).

Carried forward: ruff check and format are clean on the changed files; the Module Cohesion guide prefers a new module over appending a new concern to a large file, and the live tests and their constants were appended to test_live_route_pricing.py although it is not about route pricing. The guide does not mark this blocking, so it is recorded, not raised as a finding.
The new SQL fragment is built from constant strings and fixed column names only; no request input reaches it, and it keeps the sel session scope. The fix-up is test-only.

finding_status.notes: Fix-up commit ba4fc5cc7f adds test_live_session_skill_count_matches_the_skill_bars_however_each_skill_was_started, asserting detail skill_count == len(skill bars) == 2 for a mixed slash-started and Skill-tool session; mutation check shows it fails on the old handler behaviour, and 17/17 live tests pass on PG 17 and PG 14.
